in_hindi.name: चरुचंद्र
in_hindi.long_meaning: पूज्य सूर्य और चन्द्रमा (Charu and Chandra, both revered)

in_marathi.name: Charuchandra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon and Light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charuchandra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Charu means 'moon' and Chandra means 'light'. This name is derived from Sanskrit and represents the embodiment of the divine light of the moon.

in_bengali.name: Charuchandra
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon and Light
in_bengali.long_meaning: Charuchandra একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Charu means 'moon' and Chandra means 'light'. This name is derived from Sanskrit and represents the embodiment of the divine light of the moon.
